messages:
Sam (AE): Quick ask — Customer wants two OFs: Billing = Entity A, Payor = Entity B (wiring to B). They also want a 5% holdback for 90 days and parallel signing. Can legal/finance confirm path?

Priya (Sales Ops): Parallel DocuSign lanes supported. Need signer emails and tax docs before I create envelope.

Sam (AE): Signers: legal@entitya.com, treasury@entityb.com. I'll request W-9/W-8 and bank form.

Marina (Customer): I'll attach W-9 (A), W-8 (B), and a short intercompany memo to the envelope.

Jordan (Legal): We can accept multi-entity payment but want single MSA + separate OFs. Redline: Billing vs Payor clause, require intercompany agreement and tax/docs, tie holdback release to written acceptance or milestone, and cap aggregate holdback exposure.

Kenji (Finance): Finance provisional ok. Require W-9/W-8, bank beneficiary info. Holdback affects revenue recognition; we'll hold activation until docs verified.

Sam (AE): Jordan 1 please paste a one-paragraph redline we can send now.

Jordan (Legal): Redline text: `Order Form shall identify Billing Entity (invoiced party) and may identify a Payor Entity authorized to remit payment. Redwood will accept wiring instructions for a Payor Entity provided Customer delivers (i) evidence of the Payor-Billing Entity relationship, and (ii) tax and bank documentation for each entity. Any contractual holdback not to exceed 5% shall be released upon Redwood's written acceptance of the applicable POC deliverables or upon mutual written agreement. Redwood reserves the right to limit aggregate holdback exposure to the total value of services rendered under the POC.`

Priya (Sales Ops): I'll prepare envelope with parallel lanes and an internal "holdback" flag to route to Finance prior to activation.

Kenji (Finance): We'll review docs within 1 business day. If DocuSign completes before docs arrive, Ops will block activation.

Sam (AE): Plan: collect docs, upload to DocuSign, include Jordan's redline, wait for Finance sign-off. Marina — thanks for quick uploads. :thumbsup:
